name: Go

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services: 
      mysql:
        image: mysql
        env:
          MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD: yes
          MYSQL_DATABASE: casbin
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
      postgres:
        image: postgres
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v4
        with:
          go-version: '1.24'

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Unit tests
        run: go test -v -coverprofile=profile.cov ./...
      
      - name: Install goveralls
        run: go install github.com/mattn/goveralls@latest

      - name: Send coverage
        env:
          COVERALLS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: goveralls -coverprofile=profile.cov -service=github

[request_definition]
r = sub, obj, act

[policy_definition]
p = sub, obj, act

[role_definition]
g = _, _

[policy_effect]
e = some(where (p.eft == allow))

[matchers]
m = g(r.sub, p.sub) && r.obj == p.obj && r.act == p.act

name: Release

# Releases are cut by hand: nothing here runs on a merge, only on a pushed tag.
#
#   v3.7.0-rc1  ->  GitHub pre-release (the candidate put up for the Apache vote)
#   v3.7.0      ->  GitHub release; Go users pick the module up from the tag
#
# Either way the release carries an Apache-style source tarball as its only
# asset. The release manager downloads that tarball and signs / checksums it
# locally before starting the vote; nothing is signed or uploaded here.

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  # Base name of the source release artifact, per Apache naming conventions.
  ARTIFACT_BASENAME: apache-casbin-xorm-adapter

jobs:
  release:
    name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
    if: github.repository == 'apache/casbin-xorm-adapter'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Resolve version from tag
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          # v3.7.0-rc1 -> 3.7.0. The tarball the PPMC votes on is the exact tarball
          # that ships, so the candidate counter is never part of its name.
          BASE_VERSION="${VERSION%%-rc*}"
          if [ "$VERSION" = "$BASE_VERSION" ]; then
            PRERELEASE=false
          else
            PRERELEASE=true
          fi
          if ! echo "$VERSION" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-rc[0-9]+)?$'; then
            echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME is not vX.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z-rcN."
            exit 1
          fi
          {
            echo "base_version=$BASE_VERSION"
            echo "prerelease=$PRERELEASE"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME -> version $BASE_VERSION (pre-release: $PRERELEASE)"

      - name: Verify go.mod matches the tag
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Go resolves vN.x.y tags (N >= 2) only for a module whose path ends in
          # /vN, and v0 / v1 tags only for a module without such a suffix.
          MODULE="$(awk '/^module /{print $2; exit}' go.mod)"
          MAJOR="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          MAJOR="${MAJOR%%.*}"
          if [[ "${MODULE##*/}" =~ ^v([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
            OK=$([ "$MAJOR" = "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" ] && echo true || echo false)
          else
            OK=$([ "$MAJOR" -le 1 ] && echo true || echo false)
          fi
          if [ "$OK" != true ]; then
            echo "::error::go.mod declares $MODULE but the tag is $GITHUB_REF_NAME."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build source release tarball
        id: package
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          NAME="${ARTIFACT_BASENAME}-${{ steps.version.outputs.base_version }}-incubating-src"
          ASSET="${RUNNER_TEMP}/${NAME}.tar.gz"
          # git archive gives us exactly the tracked sources at this tag, unpacking
          # into a single top-level directory named after the release.
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="$NAME/" -o "$ASSET" HEAD
          echo "asset=$ASSET" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          ls -l "$ASSET"

      - name: Publish GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          ASSET: ${{ steps.package.outputs.asset }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          FLAGS=(--title "$TAG" --generate-notes)
          if [ "${{ steps.version.outputs.prerelease }}" = "true" ]; then
            FLAGS+=(--prerelease)
          fi
          gh release create "$TAG" "$ASSET" "${FLAGS[@]}"

default: lint test

test:
	go test -race -v .

lint:
	golangci-lint run --verbose

module github.com/apache/casbin-xorm-adapter/v3

go 1.12

require (
	github.com/casbin/casbin/v3 v3.10.0
	github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql v1.6.0
	github.com/lib/pq v1.10.2
	xorm.io/xorm v1.3.2
)

p, alice, data1, read
p, bob, data2, write
p, data2_admin, data2, read
p, data2_admin, data2, write
g, alice, data2_admin
